correctness.rationale: For independent uniform source X in {0,1}^n, n>=4, deleting two disjoint length-two bursts and counting DISTINCT length-n-4 outputs, delay-two changes T_i=1_{X_i != X_{i+2}} are independent fair Bernoulli. The proof specializes the published canonical burst-deletion normal form to a pointwise exact quadratic count. Expanding in centered Z_i=T_i-1/2 gives linear coefficients (m-2)/2 at endpoints and (m-3)/2 internally, and quadratic weights -1 at distance two, +1 at >=3. Orthogonality yields E B_n=(n^2-3n+4)/8 and Var B_n=(n-4)(2n^2-15n+31)/32. The quadratic remainder has variance O(n²), while the linear independent-sum term is asymptotically n^{3/2}/4 times a standard normal; CLT and Slutsky prove the Gaussian limit. n=4 yields constant 1. Independent direct enumeration of all 2040 binary source words of length 4 through 10 constructed UNIQUE deletion outputs, matched the pointwise canonical polynomial and exactly matched the mean/variance at each length. The all-n canonical lemma belongs to Wang et al.; finite cases do not prove that lemma.

evidence: Their published abstracts cover general b and multiple bursts for canonical structural bounds and maximum sphere sizes; such generality in channel parameters alone does not establish random-center fluctuations.
